title: Bound the fixed chart-246 correction for role 1261
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7481, fusing role 1261’s rank-three MOVEs 38490 and 39433 removes an early chart-509 contact. Replacing both old signed ADDs requires the historical correction (old910 at pre39438 + old953 at pre39441)/2 in chart 246 before ADD39469.

The probe x894=2 zeros all seven fixed donors while the correction is 1. The independent literal replay gives old role1191=0 after ADD39469 and unrepaired role1191=−1. The protected source and earlier owned/COPY guards agree on the probe. Any repair using only the receiver and the seven read-only donors would need self coefficient zero, ruling out invertible single-receiver ADD/SCALE repair at this cut.

## Scope and replay

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Exact #7481 head 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 head 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. #7494 tests moving the original ADD at this same MOVE pair, with both relocations empty. This test allows a new combination of the seven unchanged coframed donors. The projected gross was 0.25649690068998409–0.25649690068998410 raw across 17 signed calls. One extra rank-one child per call would consume it. No positive construction reached physical or application replay.

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-role1261-telescope-bound/replay.py
```

Expect `PASS_ROLE1261_TELESCOPE_BOUND`. Both 30-second checks finished with one cut exhausted and zero unresolved. Direct, registered and read-only Git-free replay, exact committed source and mode checks, and all 27 local onboarding tests passed. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestors.

## Credit and open questions

#7481/#7480/#7334 supply the native lineage, #7113 the signed caller, #7494 and #7003 the contact-timing precedents, #7482 exact covectors, #7298 directed pricing, and #7508 the public pinned source copies. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging.

Joint changes to writable rows, other cuts and funded routes remain open. Name the exact changed donor version and its already-paid carrier before testing another repair.
